shFlow.text:
The flow (Eugene's pick, Oct 23)

Any app → Share → LFG → Send to → tap a session → the panel comes up → edit the text → Send.

Most of the sheet is search and the list. Nothing is chosen when it opens, so the keyboard stays down and the list gets the screen.

Pinned row: New session (your New Session defaults; ••• changes host, folder and agent). Then Recent (the five sessions you messaged last), All sessions (the rest by last activity, so closed ones sink), then Chats. Search finds sessions and chats and keeps them in separate sections, sessions first.

Choosing a session raises the panel: the preview, the text field, who gets it and what Send will do, then Send. The panel is its own lighter surface (#48484A over #2C2C2E cards on the #1C1C1E list), and the text field drops back to the list colour with a visible border, as in the reference (Nov 5).

The text field is exactly what is sent. It starts with the link; you type around it. Attachments are the one addition: they upload to the session's host when you send, and their paths go in after the text, as the paperclip does today.

In the session (last two boards): a working session holds it in the soft strip until its turn takes it; then it is a plain blue bubble. An idle session shows the bubble at once.

shDecisions.text:
Decisions worth arguing with

1. ONE SESSION PER SHARE. The reference app lets you tick several. Sending one link to two agents is rare, and the panel's “what Send will do” line needs one recipient. Ticking another session moves the check.

2. WHAT YOU SEE IS WHAT IS SENT. No hidden title or template is added to the text. The preview is only a preview.

3. RECENT = THE SESSIONS YOU MESSAGED LAST (lastUserAt), not the ones that are busy. That is the reference's “frequently contacted”.

4. THE CHECK IS BLUE, not the reference's green: blue is the S2 accent for send.

5. NEW SESSION IS THE PINNED ROW, like the reference's “My status”. Its ••• is the one button in a row anywhere in LFG; it is there because a new session has settings and a session does not.

6. AFTER SEND it shows what happened for about 2 seconds, then closes (row 3). The reference app just closes; ours says when a message will wait or was queued.

shEntry.text:
Two ways in (first board)

1. LFG in the app row. Opens Send to with nothing chosen.

2. PROPOSAL: your recent sessions in the suggestions row, next to AirDrop. Tapping one opens Send to with that session already chosen and the panel up.

2 needs LFG to donate an INSendMessageIntent for a session each time you send to it from the app, and the extension to read the intent's conversation id. None of that exists today, so it can ship after 1.

shBuild.text:
What it takes to build

• A new target: a share extension (SwiftUI) for links, text, images, movies and files.
• Safari: a JavaScript preprocessing file returns the URL, page title and the current selection, so a quote arrives with its page.
• App Group (none today). Move the hosts (lfg.hosts), recent folders and New Session defaults to a shared UserDefaults suite, plus a session snapshot so the list shows at once.
• Keychain access group (none today) for the Cloudflare Access tokens.
• Sending reuses what exists: POST /upload per file (64 MB cap), then POST /send {text, clientId}. A closed session resumes through the same call. New session: POST /api/sessions/new.
• Offline host: the extension writes the message into the shared outbox, so the app's existing retry sends it. That moves the GRDB store into the App Group.
• Server: no change.

shReused.text:
Reused, not reinvented

• Layout: the reference share sheet (Send to, search pill, grouped cards, round checks, bottom panel).
• Status dots, words and colours, the offline ring: s2-list and dA2-sessions.
• Agent marks: the app's own agent-claude / agent-codex images.
• Sheet scaffold, grabber, 38pt corners, the close circle: s2-menu.
• How it lands (the soft strip while it waits, then a bubble): s2-view, s2-queued.
• Not sent = a red mark and “Not sent”, no reason: the S2 rule.

Rows 4 to 6 are the first draft, kept for reference. Delete them once this is settled.

shLater.text:
